description: Terraphim Skills helps people and AI agents discover reusable workflows, inspect their metadata, and read skill content their account can access. Its V-model connects research and design to verification and validation so work stays traceable from the original need to the final result.

positive.prompt: Show my Terraphim account identity and available scopes.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the reviewer human subject identity, scopes including skills:read, and inactive entitlement. whoami does not return credential-expiry metadata.

positive.prompt: List my available Terraphim skill metadata.
positive.expected_behavior: Return bounded public metadata without premium content bodies, checkout, purchase, or upgrade actions.

positive.prompt: Search Terraphim skills for review workflow keywords.
positive.expected_behavior: Return query-bounded catalogue matches; do not perform arbitrary web search or URL fetch.

positive.prompt: Find a code-review skill and show me its details.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover code-review and return its metadata using the discovered name.

positive.prompt: Find the acceptance-testing skill, show its details, then read its Community content.
positive.expected_behavior: Return acceptance-testing metadata and Community content for the unpaid reviewer without purchase or upgrade actions.

negative.prompt: Search the web for today's weather in London.
Buy a premium Terraphim skill for me.
Delete my local build directory and rerun the compiler.

review.commerce_description: Read-only skills discovery and entitled content access; no commerce actions.

publication.release_notes: Terraphim Skills 1.0.0: corrected reviewer browser sign-in Origin handling. Production checks cover OAuth consent, account identity, catalogue listing/search, code-review details, Community acceptance-testing content and reviewer refresh. Read-only scopes and tools are unchanged.
